ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious Windows Feature Enabled
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects usage of the built-in PowerShell cmdlet "Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature" used as a Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool.
Similar to DISM.exe, this cmdlet is used to enumerate, install, uninstall, configure, and update features and packages in Windows images
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Enable\\-WindowsOptionalFeature.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Online.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-FeatureName.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TelnetServer.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Internet\\-Explorer\\-Optional\\-amd64.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*TFTP.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*SMB1Protocol.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Client\\-ProjFS.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Microsoft\\-Windows\\-Subsystem\\-Linux.*")))
